The flat comprises a spacious open kitchen with a stylishly attached dining area, a magnificent living room, two bright double bedrooms, two modern bathrooms and ample storage. The residence offers residents comprehensive high-end living amenities, including concierge service, on-site parking spaces, ample storage space and communal gardens, as well as riverside leisure areas, perfectly catering to daily living and social needs. This area is well-endowed with abundant educational resources. Within walking or short commuting distance, you can reach UCL School of Management, UCL East Campus and Queen Mary University of London White City Campus. By public transport, it is also easily accessible to UCL, LSE, KCL and other universities in London. Three major transport hubs are within easy walking reach: Bromley-by-Bow Tube Station (District / Hammersmith & City Lines), Devons Road DLR Station and Bow Church Station. Thanks to well-connected underground and DLR networks, residents can travel swiftly to Central London and major commercial districts for efficient daily commuting. Surrounded by a vibrant local community, the neighbourhood boasts diverse international restaurants, cosy cafes and traditional pubs to satisfy all dining and leisure demands. Convenient local shopping centres and large supermarkets make daily errands effortless. For relaxation, riverside trails are ideal for jogging and strolling. The surrounding area is also equipped with theatres, community libraries and bustling business zones, blending peaceful natural scenery with urban prosperity to fully meet all-round living needs.
